name: camera
meaning: CAMERA property from Scn_GetPropCamera in PostLoadInit (0x49b655); Update reads it for Camera_StartScripted

name: iconQuads
meaning: two icon quads: Init loops with lea [base + i*0x14 + 0x70] (0x49b7e8, 0x49b7fb); DrawBonusList moves and draws one of them

name: scrollText
meaning: its address goes to ScrollText_Init / Draw / Update (0x49c28a, 0x49c93f, 0x49c9c7)

name: viewerNeedsDraw
meaning: set to 1 after the picture loads (0x49c65e), tested (0x49c6cb) and cleared (0x49c6e6)

name: unknownB8
meaning: Update stores 1 on picture load (0x49c644); no purpose established

name: points
meaning: read with movsx before the price comparison (0x49c3f3); remaining points stored at 0x49c42e

name: promptState
meaning: 0x49c33f `add eax,0xbe` / push passes its address as Ui_PromptYesNo 0x53f2c7's 4th argument (the outer call cleans 0x10 at 0x49c371). Persistent yes/no prompt state, seeded 0x10 by Reset, which is why screen 3 tests the reply against 0x10

name: screen
meaning: 0 closed, 1 opening, 2 browse, 3 confirm, 4 purchase completed, 5 not enough points (0x49c3f3-0x49c4af), 6 open bonus file, 7/9 waits, 8 image viewer, 0xA/0xB prev/next slide, 0xC scroll-text, 0xD leave

name: backdropFade
meaning: Reset stores 7 (0x49cc04); Update counts it down and passes it to Ui_DrawMemCardBackdrop

name: viewerDelay
meaning: movzx at 0x49c69a, compared with 10 on viewer entry/exit

name: firstVisible
meaning: movzx at 0x49c0db: first row of the four-item scrolling window

name: cursor
meaning: movsx at 0x49c09d: selected bonus 0..7, indexes the 12-byte bonus table

name: boughtSomething
meaning: read with movsx at 0x49ca6e so s8, and it is set on screen 4 (0x49c508, the purchase-completed arm), not screen 5. On leaving, a set value plus Progress+0xb4 bits 4 and 5 sends MSG_MCARD_AUTOSAVE 0x3500 to class 0x62
